title: Tripadvisor: planeje viagens – Apps no Google Play

facts.fact: The Tripadvisor app on Google Play has an average rating of 4.5 stars, as shown on the listing page.
The Tripadvisor app on Google Play has 1.47 million reviews, as shown on the listing page.
The Tripadvisor app on Google Play shows more than 100 million downloads.
The Google Play listing for the Tripadvisor app was last updated on 3 November 2026.
According to Tripadvisor's own description, its app compares hotel rates from more than 200 booking sites worldwide.
facts.quote: comparando as diárias mais baixas de mais de 200 sites de reservas do mundo

facts.fact: The Tripadvisor app's Google Play content rating is listed as 'Todos' (all audiences).
The Tripadvisor app on Google Play is labeled as containing advertisements.
Tripadvisor states that bookings for hotels, tours, activities and experiences can be made with free cancellation.
facts.quote: Reserve hotéis, excursões, atividades, experiências e muito mais com cancelamento gratuito

facts.fact: According to the Google Play data safety section, the app may share data with third parties in the categories 'Local, Informações pessoais e mais 3'.
According to the Google Play data safety section, the app may collect data in the categories 'Local, Informações pessoais e mais 6'.
The developer reports that the app's data is encrypted in transit.
facts.quote: Os dados são criptografados em trânsito
